name: Capture
description: A capture toolbar: screenshots of a region, window or screen, screen and sound recordings with a timer pill, driven by the keyboard, the mouse or a game controller

mode.description: The mode the toolbar opens in the first time: screenshot, video or audio

target.description: What that mode captures first: region, window, output (the focused screen) or screen (every screen, screenshots only)

delay.description: Seconds to wait before a screenshot or video starts: 0, 3, 5 or 10

desktopAudio.description: Recordings start with what the speakers play

microphone.description: Recordings start with the default microphone

audioFormat.description: A sound recording's format: mp3, opus, flac, wav, m4a or ogg

pill.description: Show a pill with the elapsed time and a stop button while a recording runs

controller.description: Read a game controller while the toolbar is open or a recording runs (python3): the D-pad moves, A presses, B closes, LT/RT change the mode, LB/RB the target, Start captures and the Guide button stops a recording

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.capture to drive the toolbar without a keyboard
